app.tagline: Paste a link. Pick a quality. Done.
app.legal: Only grab stuff you own or have permission to download.

common.restartRequired: Takes effect after restarting the app.

home.title: Download from any link.
home.subtitle: Paste a link from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, X and over a thousand other sites.
home.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a link.
home.dropHint: or drop a link or a .txt file with links
home.dropNoLinks: No links found in what you dropped.
home.shortcutHint: Press {{keys}} anywhere to paste and analyze

batch.subtitle: Download them all at once with a preset, or analyze a single one first.

badges.mergedHint: This stream has no sound. The best audio track will be merged in automatically.

video.noFormats: No video streams were found. Try the Audio tab.
video.containerHint: MP4 plays everywhere. MKV keeps every codec and subtitle. WebM suits VP9/AV1 streams.
video.playlistHint: Formats differ per item, so pick a quality cap — each item gets its best match up to that.

subtitles.none: No subtitles are available for this item.
subtitles.hintEmbed: Selected subtitles are embedded when you download from the Video tab. Download from here to get only the subtitle files.

spotify.title: Audio comes from a matched source
spotify.body: Spotify audio is DRM-protected and is never downloaded from Spotify. Dlyven reads the track details, finds a matching publicly available recording (YouTube Music) and tags the file with Spotify's title, artist, album and cover. The audio version and quality may differ from Spotify.

result.noSubsSelected: Select at least one subtitle language.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Everything in progress and recently finished.
downloads.emptyBody: Paste a link on the Home screen to get started.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every finished download, searchable.
history.search: Search by title, channel or link…
history.emptyBody: Finished downloads show up here so you can find them again.
history.clearBody: This only removes the list. Downloaded files stay on your disk.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved automatically.
settings.translucencyHint: Uses Mica on Windows 11 and vibrancy on macOS.
settings.rememberLastFolder: Remember the last folder I used
settings.platformFoldersHint: Send downloads from a specific site to its own folder.
settings.filenameTemplateHint: Click a field to insert it. The extension is added automatically. Illegal characters are replaced and existing files are never overwritten.
settings.speedLimitHint: Per download, in KB/s. 0 means unlimited.
settings.proxyHint: Routes analysis, downloads and engine updates through a proxy — useful on restricted networks.
settings.userAgentHint: Leave empty to use the engine's default.
settings.retriesHint: Failed network requests and downloads are retried with increasing delays.
settings.cookiesIntro: Some content (private Instagram posts, age-restricted or members-only videos) needs you to be signed in. Dlyven can use the login from your browser — your password is never seen or stored.
settings.cookiesBrowserHint: Sign in to the site in that browser first. Chrome and Edge may need to be closed while Dlyven reads cookies.
settings.cookiesFileHint: Export it with a “cookies.txt” browser extension (Netscape format).
settings.cookiesWarning: Cookies give access to your accounts. Only use files you exported yourself, and keep them private.
settings.engineIntro: Dlyven uses yt-dlp to read links, ffmpeg to merge and convert, and Deno to unlock every YouTube format. They're installed and verified automatically.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Sites change often; keeping yt-dlp current avoids most errors.
settings.clipboardWatchHint: When you switch back to Dlyven, offer to analyze a copied link.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Copies versions, settings (passwords removed) and recent log lines to share in a bug report.
settings.resetBody: Your downloads and history are kept. Language stays the same.

engine.settingUpBody: One-time setup. Files are downloaded from their official sources and verified.

ERR_UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
ERR_UNKNOWN.hint: Try again. If it keeps happening, update the engine or copy diagnostic info from Settings.

ERR_INVALID_URL.title: That isn't a valid link
ERR_INVALID_URL.hint: Copy the full address from your browser, starting with https://.

ERR_UNSUPPORTED_URL.title: This site isn't supported
ERR_UNSUPPORTED_URL.hint: Try the direct link to the video or post page rather than a home or search page.

ERR_LOGIN_REQUIRED.title: You need to be signed in
ERR_LOGIN_REQUIRED.hint: This content needs a login. Turn on “Use cookies from my browser” in Login & cookies settings.

ERR_AGE_RESTRICTED.title: Age-restricted content
ERR_AGE_RESTRICTED.hint: Sign in through your browser cookies with an account that can view it.

ERR_PRIVATE.title: This content is private
ERR_PRIVATE.hint: Only accounts with access can view it. Use cookies from a browser where you're signed in with such an account.

ERR_GEO_BLOCKED.title: Not available in your region
ERR_GEO_BLOCKED.hint: Try a proxy located in a region where this content is available.

ERR_NOT_FOUND.title: Content not found
ERR_NOT_FOUND.hint: It may have been deleted or the link is incomplete.

ERR_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
ERR_RATE_LIMITED.hint: The site is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes, sign in with cookies, or use a proxy.

ERR_NETWORK.title: Network problem
ERR_NETWORK.hint: Check your connection. On restricted networks, set up a proxy in Network settings.

ERR_TIMEOUT.title: The connection timed out
ERR_TIMEOUT.hint: The server is slow or unreachable. Try again, raise the timeout, or use a proxy.

ERR_PROXY.title: Couldn't connect through the proxy
ERR_PROXY.hint: Check the proxy type, address, port and login in Network settings.

ERR_COOKIES.title: Couldn't read browser cookies
ERR_COOKIES.hint: Close the browser completely and try again, or export a cookies.txt file instead.

ERR_FFMPEG_MISSING.title: ffmpeg is missing
ERR_FFMPEG_MISSING.hint: It's needed to merge and convert. Install the engine from Settings.

ERR_ENGINE_MISSING.title: The download engine isn't installed
ERR_ENGINE_MISSING.hint: Install it now — it takes about a minute.

ERR_ENGINE_INSTALL.title: Couldn't install the engine
ERR_ENGINE_INSTALL.hint: Check your connection or proxy and try again. You can also set custom tool paths in Settings.

ERR_CHECKSUM.title: Download verification failed
ERR_CHECKSUM.hint: The file didn't match its official checksum and was discarded. Try again later.

ERR_DISK.title: Couldn't write the file
ERR_DISK.hint: Check there's enough free space and that the folder is writable.

ERR_LIVE_NOT_STARTED.title: Live or upcoming stream
ERR_LIVE_NOT_STARTED.hint: Live streams can't be downloaded. Try again after the stream has ended.

ERR_FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE.title: That quality isn't available
ERR_FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Pick another quality or use a preset.

ERR_SPOTIFY_UNSUPPORTED.title: This Spotify link isn't supported
ERR_SPOTIFY_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Podcasts and shows can't be matched. Tracks, albums, playlists and artists work.

ERR_SPOTIFY_MATCH.title: No matching source found
ERR_SPOTIFY_MATCH.hint: We couldn't find a public recording of this track.

ERR_BUSY.title: Please wait
ERR_BUSY.hint: Another engine operation is still running.

ERR_JOB_NOT_FOUND.title: Download not found
ERR_JOB_NOT_FOUND.hint: It may have been removed already.
